disclaimer: Example onboarding policy written for a hackathon demo. Not a real company's policy. Daily stop targets below are policy-defined ramp limits, not predictions of a worker's productivity.

review.rule: R-REV-1: If the CV and questionnaire disagree on delivery experience by more than 1 year, or a fact the track depends on is uncertain, a manager must resolve it before the plan can be approved.

tracks.label: Experienced Courier track
tracks.rule: R-TRACK-1: At least 2 years of parcel or route delivery experience shown in the CV, plus a driver's license, qualifies for the Experienced track.

tracks.label: Courier Foundations track
tracks.rule: R-TRACK-2: Everyone else starts on Foundations: three ride-along days, then a gradual ramp that reaches the standard route in week 4.

modules.title: Safety, hazmat awareness and incident reporting
modules.rule: R-MOD-1: Required for every new worker regardless of experience.

modules.title: Hours-of-service and break rules
modules.rule: R-MOD-2: Required for every new worker.

modules.title: Handheld scanner and proof of delivery
modules.rule: R-MOD-3: Required for everyone; prior handheld scanner use shortens it to a 30-minute refresher on the Fleetwing app.

modules.title: Safe lifting and hand-truck technique
modules.rule: R-MOD-4: Required for every new worker.

modules.title: Pre-trip box truck inspection
modules.rule: R-MOD-5: Required for anyone who will drive a Fleetwing vehicle.

modules.title: Defensive driving course
modules.rule: R-MOD-6: Required on the Foundations track before solo driving.

modules.title: Customer handoff, signatures and damaged-package reporting
modules.rule: R-MOD-7: Required on the Foundations track.

modules.title: Route sequencing in the Fleetwing dispatch app
modules.rule: R-MOD-8: Experienced couriers learn Fleetwing's dispatch app instead of general route training.

modules.title: Mentor ride-along
modules.rule: R-MOD-9: One ride-along day on Experienced, three on Foundations.

scheduleRule: R-SCHED-1: Ride-along and on-route days start at the worker's preferred shift time.
